nodes.description: BotProtected.owner: privileged owner address, assigned from tx.origin in the YDragon constructor
BotProtected.botProtection: external contract invoked through low-level calls in the checkBots modifier and in list()
BotProtected.uniPair: Uniswap pair address passed as an argument to the bot-protection callback
YDragon.balanceOf: holder balances updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and overwritten in list
YDragon.allowance: approval mapping decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom
YDragon.totalSupply: initialized to 400000000000000000000000000 and used for the unchecked 6% allocation
YDragon.routerForUniswap: Uniswap V2 router used for addLiquidityETH in list()
YDragon.wrappedBinance: wrapped ETH token address used to derive the pair
BotProtected constructor: stores the botProtection address supplied at deployment
checkBots modifier: performs a low-level call to botProtection and requires success before the modified body runs
YDragon.transfer: payable function that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
YDragon.transferFrom: payable transfer guarded by checkBots that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic
YDragon.approve: sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval
YDragon.delegate: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata
YDragon.pairOf: computes the Uniswap CREATE2 pair address from two tokens
YDragon.list: owner-only listing that calls addLiquidityETH, makes a low-level call and distributes balances in a loop
YDragon constructor: sets owner from tx.origin, derives uniPair and grants infinite allowances
msg.sender: caller used for allowance checks, owner checks and balance writes
block.timestamp: used to build the Uniswap deadline block.timestamp + 600 in list()
tx.origin: used as contract owner and given an infinite uniPair allowance in the constructor
